list.content: TICKETS Drawings are every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday night. Purchase Powerball tickets at any participating retailer. It’s $2 per play. Or, $3 with optional Power Play. Tickets may be purchased until 9 p.m. central on the evening of the draw.

A new feature called Double Play will give players another chance to match their Powerball numbers in a separate drawing with a top cash prize of $10 million. NUMBERS Select five numbers from 1 to 69 for white balls; then select one number from 1 to 26 for the red Powerball.
WINNING Players win a prize by matching some or all of the numbers drawn. Head to the Players Club to Check Your Numbers and find out if you're a winner.
LEARN MORE Visit the Powerball website to learn more.

Prizes of $100 or Less

Sign the back of your ticket and present it to your local lottery retailer.

Prizes of $101 or More

These must be paid by the Lottery. You can claim your prize by mail:
  • Sign the back of the ticket in the space provided.
  • Fill out a claim form, available at your local lottery retailer. Or use the online Claim Form. Simply type in your information, print it off, sign and date it.
  • Send the completed claim form and winning ticket to the Lottery at 711 E Wells Ave., Pierre, SD 57501.
  • You should receive your prize money in 7-10 days.

• You may also claim your prize in person by visiting one of our validation centers in Pierre, Rapid City or Sioux Falls.
  • Any jackpot-winning ticket or the second prizes for Powerball must be presented in person at a Lottery office. A jackpot-winning Powerball ticket must be presented in person at the Lottery office in Pierre at 711 E Wells Ave., Pierre, SD 57501.

Jackpot Winner?

Congratulations! Our first advice is that you immediately sign the back of the ticket and put it in a safe place. We strongly encourage you to take your time and seek professional financial and legal advice. We also offer a Winner’s Handbook with some tips to help you. When you’re ready, give us a call to make arrangements to validate the ticket and claim your prize.

layouts.content:
MOBILE CASHING IS HERE!

You may now securely and conveniently claim your prizes from $101 to $5,000 through the South Dakota Lottery's mobile app. Simply scan your instant or lotto tickets on the app to begin your claim via ACH transaction! To get started scan your winning scratch or lotto ticket from our app and complete your digital claim form. Your first mobile claim should be processed within 8 business days and future claims within 4 business days!

list.content: TICKETS Make the game winning play with Powerball Xs & Os. Drawings take place every Sunday night. Powerball Xs & Os tickets cost $5 per play. Purchase your Powerball Xs & Os  ticket at any participating retailer. Tickets may be purchased until 8 p.m. central on the evening of the draw.
Teams Select 8 of 32 team logos. Match some or all of the teams drawn to win.
WINNING Players can pick eight NFL team logos from a lineup of all 32 NFL teams for a chance to win a rolling jackpot. Head to the Players Club to Check Your Numbers and find out if you're a winner.

Take a Second Chance Both winning and non-winning Powerball Xs & Os tickets may be entered at www.PowerballOfficial.com to earn points. Enter your points into a series of drawings for a chance to win NFL related prizes such as NFL shop gift cards, NFL merchandise, unique gameday experiences, and even a trip to the Super Bowl! Remember, you must create a new account at www.PowerballOfficial.com to enter your tickets. Your South Dakota Lottery Players Club account will not transfer over.
